Symptoms were relieved with the first FEC-100 (5fluorouracil 500mg/m2, epirubicin 100mg/m2 and cyclophosphamide 500mg/m2) chemotherapy cycle in January 2007... Cancer treatment was completed using three docetaxel (100 mg/m2) cycles and radiation therapy (46 Gy to left sus-clavicular area, 50 Gy to left breast and 46 Gy to left internal mammary node chain). Starting June 2007 and July 2007, she received tamoxifen and goserelin, respectively.
